description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller for serving static content, with additional features for rewriting URLs and caching control, specific to OpenMRS web application.

classes.name: PseudoStaticContentController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller implementing URL rewriting, JSTL interpretation toggle, and cache control for static resources in OpenMRS.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming HTTP requests, applies URL rewrites, and appends JSTL support indicator if enabled.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns a fixed last modified timestamp when JSTL interpretation is enabled, allowing client-side caching.

methods.name: setLastModified
methods.description: Static method to update the last modified timestamp, used to invalidate cached resources.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Resets the last modified timestamp when a global property changes, prompting cache refresh.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets the last modified timestamp when a global property is deleted, prompting cache refresh.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Indicates support for any property name, returning true.

methods.name: invalidateCachedResources
methods.description: Static method to update the last modified timestamp, forcing cache invalidation for resources.
